handback.t:
R4-B1 (h4) DONE. Scope: router/case-store/shared-vector-memory footprint (not Claude's internal memory). All numbers are synthetic-until-validated. Full detail: results/h4_board_entry.md (VERIFY REQUEST blocks with rerun commands), results/h4_combined.md (claims), results/h4_predeclare.md, results/h4_proposed_patch.md.

WHAT I BUILT
- src/tiered.rs (the only src file I edited; all additions opt-in, defaults unchanged; `cargo test --release --offline --lib tiered` = 17 pass (5 new); lessons 8 and knowledge 7 still pass): ForgetPolicy {Value,Fifo,Lru}, importance-merge (`merge_sim`: absorb same-meta near-duplicates, weights/values add, ItemStats.weight), cold tier kinds F16/Int8 (ColdQ, unrolled dot kernels) besides turbovec, `hard_budget` (budget enforced on every add), TieredStats.merged.
- src/bin/h4_memory.rs + src/bin/h4_common/mod.rs: two independent world generators (A-zipf: Zipf recurring families + 30% one-off noise + drift of 25% of families; B-burst: bursty time-windowed lessons, log-normal benefit, junk traces) + controls (A-allvalued: 500 equally valuable families; A-noreuse: nothing recurs); kernel-regression case router on TieredMemory; policies full/fifo/lru/value/merge/tiered-int8/tiered-f16/tiered-int8+merge + nomem/ctxfree/full-rd references. Budgets 50/25/10% of unbounded bytes (tiered also 100%). Protocol: tune seeds 1-8, held 31-60, confirm 61-90, paired by seed, TOST margin +-0.01 (strict +-0.005) pre-declared, Holm over the main-world family, claim only if EQ in BOTH stages. Hnsw stage (patched hnsw) 10 seeds.
- Disclosed post-hoc: a non-inferiority test + tiered+merge policy added after tuning but before held; a `full-rd` (unbounded + recency-weighted vote) sensitivity reference added after the first held/confirm run, then held/confirm/hnsw were re-run (old outputs in results/h4_prev/).

RESULTS (honest)
1. Value-based forgetting (recalled-and-helped, decayed) is NOT supported: beaten by plain FIFO in A-zipf at every budget (value-fifo -0.004/-0.029/-0.054 at 50/25/10%, pooled 60 seeds, CIs exclude 0) and by FIFO at 50/25% in A-allvalued; equal in B-burst.
2. Importance-merge is the best consolidation add-on (beats value by +0.019 at 10% in A-zipf). merge@10% in A-zipf: delta +0.0011 (held) / -0.0016 (confirm): non-inferior in both, but EQ fails Holm in confirm, so NOT claimed equivalent.
3. Cleanest "free" saving = compressing the cold tier with no item dropped: tiered-int8 @100% budget keeps 59% of bytes at D=64 (41% saved; 57% saved projected to D=384 for the same retained set) with EQ at +-0.005 in BOTH stages in A-zipf, B-burst and the all-valued control. tiered-f16: 28% saved (38% projected), EQ strict, but search 5-7x slower; int8 search 1.5-1.6x slower at >=50% bytes.
4. EQ(+-0.01, Holm, both stages) at 50% bytes: lru, merge, tiered-int8, tiered-f16, tiered-int8+merge in A-zipf (knee ~50% bytes; 65% saving projected D=384 with tiered-int8) and ALL policies in B-burst down to 10% bytes (90% saved; recency-sufficient world). At 25%/10% in A-zipf no EQ claim; FIFO/tiered-int8@25% and merge/tiered-int8+merge/FIFO@10% are non-inferior (some significantly better than unbounded because stale cases get dropped, i.e. a router weakness vs drift: FIFO@25% is +0.03..+0.04 above unbounded and +0.016..+0.023 above full-rd; do not read as a general gain).
5. Controls behave: A-noreuse identical at all budgets (harmless, 90% saved). A-allvalued: forgetting costs real quality ~proportional to dropped value: flat policies -0.015..-0.037 @50%, -0.069..-0.085 @25%, -0.118..-0.132 @10% (total memory benefit is +0.167); tiered-int8 only -0.0008 @50% (EQ strict), -0.034 @25%, -0.105 @10%, beating FIFO at equal bytes by +0.015/+0.035/+0.024.
6. Latency: dropping items shrinks flat search ~linearly (0.77x @50%, 0.5x @25%, 0.29x @10%, noisy +-10%); hnsw backend gives parity quality (value-hnsw@25% 0.5748 vs flat 0.5717) and 0.61x search. Hard budget held in every run (overshoot 0).

CAVEATS: D=64 synthetic embeddings (D=384 bytes are a projection, not a rerun); no real traffic/real-embedding run; simple kernel-regression router; the recency advantage depends on temporal locality in these worlds; hyperparameters tuned on seeds 1-8 only (merge sim tuned with pre-freeze value hyperparameters). Proposals for knowledge.rs/lessons.rs (bounded `recs`, merge weights, hard budget presets) are in results/h4_proposed_patch.md; nothing outside tiered.rs/h4 files was edited, no defaults changed, no commits.
